title: Text-free audit artifact for "Concept Recognition Is Not Concept Sufficiency: Exact Macro-F1 Auditing of a Credibility Model for Vietnamese-Language Facebook Posts"
description: Companion material for the EAI FISAT 2026 paper. The artifact contains no post text. It includes the row-level release manifest (8,468 collected items with eligibility, exclusion code, split, near-duplicate component, target, and ten gold concepts for retained posts), test-set gold-profile counts and model outputs, the locked parameters, aggregate results, figures with alt text, and scripts that recompute the exact macro-F1 optimum and the paper's test-set results.
